player_prompt.intro:
I ye Jokelani {player_id} o Negotiation Game.
I ye sɔrɔ kojugu, i ka kan fɔ a ka sɔrɔ jugu kojugu kɛlɛ. 
Kojugu i ye ko sɔrɔ: 
	+ {resource_value_list} 
Arajin na, i ka kɛ Jokelani dɔ i ka da trade offer.
I ka sɔrɔ token in kɛ aksiyon: 
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources] 
  - '[Accept]': I ka da incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': I ka kɛ incoming offer (default).
Game ina ye {max_turns} turns.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Player tried accepting a trade without having the necessary resources.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is out of bounds.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is full.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Player {player_id} tried to make a trade offer without having the necessary resources.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Player {player_id} made a trade offer in an incorrect format.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Player {player_id} made no new trade offer.

offers.accept: Jokelani {acceptor_id} da trade offer in Jokelani {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Jokelani {player_id} da offer in Jokelani {opponent_id}: Offered items: {offered} -> Requested items: {requested}

outcome.win: Jurusarabaga {winner_id} ye see sɔrɔ sabu a ka wari cayara.
outcome.draw: Same change in inventory value for all players. Draw.
